validate_aya_vision_architecture: validate the AyaVisionConfig architecture ensuring vision_feature_select_strategy is 'default' or 'full'
build_aya_vision_config_custom_vision: build an AyaVisionConfig with a custom siglip_vision_model config for vision_feature_layer and downsample_factor
